how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-felwood-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:939:obj:0: Bring the Flute of Xavaric and 5 Jadefire Felbind samples to Eridan Bluewind in southern ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:939:details:0: You study the simple wooden flute you picked up after defeating Xavaric.
rows.quest:939:details:1: BThe knotted wood feels solid, but it seems as if the spirals and patterns in the surface begin to spin and move as you turn it over in your hands. Suddenly, you feel a sense of dread...
rows.quest:939:details:2: BYou shake your head, sure that your mind is playing tricks on you.
rows.quest:939:details:3: BIt's possible that other satyrs carry clues as to what you have found. Bring your findings to the druid, Eridan Bluewind, that lives in southern ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:939:completion:0: I sense the suffering of ancient ones, ⟦1⟧...
rows.quest:939:completion:1: BHolding these items is almost unbearable...
rows.quest:4101:obj:0: Bring 15 Blood Amber to Arathandris Silversky in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:4101:details:0: Plants give life to ⟦E1⟧, yet even they suffer the taint of corruption. I know ways to cleanse them, but I cannot give out such knowledge to those I don't know or trust. Prove to me that you will truly aid the cause of the Cenarion Circle!
rows.quest:4101:details:1: BTo the north lie the Irontree Caverns. The Warpwood elementals present there are now beyond hope of cleansing. I ask you to bring me their sap - blood amber it is called - so I may study it in the hopes of saving other forms of life here.
rows.quest:4101:completion:0: This blood amber will be used to find a means of defeating the corruption present in ⟦E1⟧. You've proven to me that you're willing to do whatever it takes for the Cenarion Circle. I trust you now, friend.
rows.quest:4101:completion:1: BIt might seem odd that killing the elementals proved yourself to me, but the end of saving countless sentient beings must justify the means we take. You and I can now focus on the preservation of life through the salves I can make.
rows.quest:4101:completion:2: B⟦2⟧, the time has come to cleanse ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:4102:obj:0: Bring 15 Blood Amber to Maybess Riverbreeze in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:4102:details:0: Plants give life to ⟦E1⟧, yet even they suffer the taint of corruption. I know ways to cleanse them, but I cannot give out such knowledge to those I don't know or trust. Prove to me that you will truly aid the cause of the Cenarion Circle!
rows.quest:4102:details:1: BTo the north lie the Irontree Caverns. The Warpwood elementals present there are now beyond hope of cleansing. I ask you to bring me their sap - blood amber it is called - so I may study it in the hopes of saving other forms of life here.
rows.quest:4102:completion:0: This blood amber will be used to find a means of defeating the corruption present in ⟦E1⟧. You've proven to me that you're willing to do whatever it takes for the Cenarion Circle. I trust you now, friend.
rows.quest:4102:completion:1: BIt might seem odd that killing the elementals proved yourself to me, but the end of saving countless sentient beings must justify the means we take. You and I can now focus on the preservation of life through the salves I can make.
rows.quest:4102:completion:2: B⟦3⟧, the time has come to cleanse ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:4261:obj:0: Escort Arei to safety, then speak with Kayneth Stillwind in Forest Song, in eastern ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:4261:details:0: ⟦E1⟧ was once a peaceful and serene land... Until the legion took hold. The infernals, destruction, chaos...
rows.quest:4261:details:1: BThe skull of Gul'dan ensured that none were spared here. All fell to the corruption.
rows.quest:4261:details:2: BEven now, as a spirit, I still find myself trapped, bearing the suffering of this land. Help me find my way home. Please, ⟦4⟧, tell me you will lead an ancient spirit away from here, where I may finally rest.
rows.quest:4261:details:3: BOnce I am free, seek out Kayneth Stillwind, a druid that resides in Forest Song, to the east.
rows.quest:4261:completion:0: Yes, ⟦5⟧. ⟦E1⟧ has been through much hardship. Thank you for what you have done.
rows.quest:4261:completion:1: BOne day, we may be able to reclaim ⟦E1⟧ from the corruption; every kind deed helps.
rows.quest:4421:obj:0: Kill 11 Jadefire Felsworns, 9 Jadefire Shadowstalkers, 9 Jadefire Rogues, and Xavathras. Return to Eridan Bluewind in ⟦E1⟧ when the task has been completed.
rows.quest:4421:details:0: Not many seek adventure here... ⟦E1⟧'s corruption is widespread and indiscriminate.
rows.quest:4421:details:1: BAs part of the Emerald Circle, I seek to heal this land, but there are some that wish it to fester.
rows.quest:4421:details:2: BThe ones I speak of are the Jadefire satyrs that dwell to the northwest of here, at the Ruins of Constellas. Led by a particularly cruel satyr named Xavathras, they continue to spread the disease to any creatures they encounter.
rows.quest:4421:details:3: BWe must defend this land that was once ours. Defeat Xavathras and destroy his minions.
rows.quest:4421:completion:0: Ridding ⟦E1⟧ of Xavathras is only the first step in a long process. It will take much work to repair the damage that has been done here.
rows.quest:4421:completion:1: BI sense that there is something much larger than just the satyrs at work here, but we will only know the truth with time...
rows.quest:4441:obj:0: ⟦E3⟧ to ⟦E4⟧ and use Eridan's Vial to collect a Vial of Blessed Water from the Temple of the Moon. Return to Eridan with the filled vial.
rows.quest:4441:details:0: The flute you found was carved from an ancient protector, the ⟦E5⟧ allies that have faithfully protected the night elves.
rows.quest:4441:details:1: BThe satyrs have been able to corrupt anything they come in contact with, which includes the ancients that made ⟦E1⟧ their home. By the use of the fel, the spirit of the ancient has been bound and tortured, never completely released. The felbind you found is no doubt related.
rows.quest:4441:details:2: BWe must try to purify the flute, ⟦6⟧. Bring me blessed water from the Temple of the Moon in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:4441:completion:0: Thank you, ⟦7⟧. Now, we must pray that we can undo the damage that has been done...
rows.quest:4442:obj:0: Speak to Eridan again in a moment.
rows.quest:4442:details:0: Using the water of ⟦E6⟧, I will attempt to purify the flute. We must end this suffering...
rows.quest:4442:details:1: BMay ⟦E6⟧ guide my hands and heart.
rows.quest:4442:details:2: BSpeak with me again in a moment.
rows.quest:4442:completion:0: With the blessed water, I was able to break the link between the flute and the ancient spirit. I do believe though, that if you were to use this flute in a sacred spot, you may be able to summon the ancient spirits.
rows.quest:4442:completion:1: BPerhaps you might try the ruins in the southern part of Irontree Woods. Many corrupted treants inhabited this area at one time, and it is possible that they may still reside there, even in ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:4505:obj:0: Collect a sample of corrupted water from the Jadefire Satyrs' moonwell and bring it to Winna Hazzard at Bloodvenom Post.
rows.quest:4505:details:0: Some may say that I am exceptionally cruel... But truly, it is only a strong desire to see the ⟦E8⟧ gain an advantage against the ⟦E9⟧, in any way possible.
rows.quest:4505:details:1: BMy newest interest is a moonwell at the Ruins of Constellas, south of here, tended by the Jadefire satyrs. The moonwell, once a symbol of renewal for the insufferable night elves, is now corrupted, and used to bring forth more satyrs.
rows.quest:4505:details:2: BI have an idea, ⟦8⟧, and I'd like a sample of the water... for my little feline friend here.
rows.quest:4505:completion:0: Very well. We must find a way to use this corruption against our enemies...
rows.quest:4506:obj:0: Take Winna's kitten to the corrupted moonwell, release it, then bring it back to Winna.
rows.quest:4506:obj:1: BOnce you have returned to Winna, click on the cat to release it to Winna.
rows.quest:4506:details:0: This corrupted water can be used to our advantage, ⟦9⟧. With just a small amount of the water, my kitten doubled in size, and seems to be stronger... somehow. These cats may prove useful...
rows.quest:4506:details:1: BHere, ⟦10⟧. Take this cat carrier, and release the kitten inside next to the moonwell in the Ruins of Constellas. Heh, heh... I'm sure you'll be pleased with the results!
rows.quest:4506:details:2: BReturn the cat to me, and I'm sure I can make it worth your time.
rows.quest:4506:completion:1: BThe forsaken will resort to any means necessary to crush the alliance! The use of the corrupted water will surely prove useful in our future efforts...
rows.quest:4521:obj:0: Trull Failbane in ⟦E1⟧ wants you to kill 15 Raging Owlbeasts and 15 Ragged Owlbeasts.
rows.quest:4521:details:0: ⟦E10⟧ lies just beyond Timbermaw, northeast of ⟦E1⟧. Have you been there?
rows.quest:4521:details:1: BI have heard that the area is laden with creatures called wildkin. These beasts have been known to guard secrets; secrets of the Night elves.
rows.quest:4521:details:2: BWe must figure out what may be hidden in ⟦E10⟧.
rows.quest:4521:details:3: BI have heard the ragged owlbeasts can be found just south of the road, and that there are others called raging owlbeasts that may be found in the center of ⟦E10⟧. Clear them out, and gain access to the land.
rows.quest:4521:completion:0: This is excellent news, ⟦11⟧. With these beasts out of the way, we can begin to adventure further into ⟦E10⟧. Are you ready for more?
rows.quest:4721:obj:0: Trull Failbane in ⟦E1⟧ wants you to hunt 10 ⟦E11⟧ Owlbeasts in ⟦E10⟧.
rows.quest:4721:details:0: Runners have returned from ⟦E10⟧ with reports that there is a series of small caves in the southern area of ⟦E10⟧. It seems that there are wildkin situated in the area around these caves. If there is something valuable that they are guarding, I believe that this is the place we will find it.
rows.quest:4721:details:1: BYou will find these to be more of a challenge than the previous types, ⟦12⟧. The creatures seem to have gone mad from exposure to the very thing that they strive to protect.
rows.quest:4721:completion:0: Hard work is something I have great respect for, ⟦13⟧. Now we can move forward with our plans for ⟦E10⟧.
rows.quest:4741:obj:0: Trull Failbane in ⟦E1⟧ wants you to hunt 13 Moontouched Owlbeasts.
rows.quest:4741:details:0: In the northern areas of ⟦E10⟧, the Wildkin grow even more ferocious. We must continue our measures there.
rows.quest:4741:details:1: BHunt the moontouched owlbeasts in ⟦E10⟧, and explore the area they inhabit.
rows.quest:4741:details:2: BThis is dangerous ground, but I know that you will be able to handle the challenge. Return to me after you have slain 13 of the wildkin.
rows.quest:4741:completion:0: I sense that you are enjoying your work. And I believe that we are onto something here.
rows.quest:4906:obj:0: Eridan Bluewind in ⟦E1⟧ wants you to kill 8 Jadefire Hellcallers, 8 Jadefire Betrayers, 8 Jadefire Tricksters, and Xavaric. Return to Eridan when the task is completed.
rows.quest:4906:details:0: A second encampment of satyrs threatens the land of ⟦E1⟧ towards the north, led by the cruel Xavaric. The vile betrayers and tricksters feed upon the corruption of the native creatures of ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:4906:details:1: BXavathras and his minions were only part of a larger plan -- to cultivate a corrupted moonwell, and then provide the spoils to Xavaric.
rows.quest:4906:details:2: BNow that Xavathras is out of the way, finish this task, ⟦14⟧. Head to the north and defeat Xavaric.
rows.quest:4906:completion:0: Thank you for all you have done, ⟦15⟧. May ⟦E6⟧ protect you and guide you on the path ahead.
rows.quest:5155:obj:0: Enter Jaedenar and slay 4 Jaedenar Hounds, 4 Jaedenar Guardsmen, 6 Jaedenar Adepts, and 6 Jaedenar Cultists before returning to Greta Mosshoof in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:5155:details:0: If I am to trust you in this matter, you will first have to prove yourself.
rows.quest:5155:details:1: BI must know that you are an enemy of the ⟦E12⟧--the ones responsible for many evils here and abroad.
rows.quest:5155:details:2: BTravel deeper into ⟦E1⟧. To the west you will see a path leading to Jaedenar. It is there that the Council plots with the ⟦E13⟧.
rows.quest:5155:details:3: BEnter the depths of one of the corrupted Barrow Dens they inhabit and slay their kind. Return to me after you've done this. Then I will know you truly seek to help us.
rows.quest:5155:completion:0: Good, ⟦16⟧! With their numbers weakening, we can further press them.
rows.quest:5155:completion:1: BHow was your first taste of their power? Were they as strong as you thought they would be? Stronger? Or perhaps they were no challenge for you at all. Wouldn't that be something?
rows.quest:5155:completion:2: BWe can discuss the details of your exploits later. There are other things we must focus on now.
rows.quest:5156:obj:0: Seek out and destroy 2 Entropic Beasts and 2 Entropic Horrors while exploring Shatter Scar Vale. After checking to see if the craters there are still filled with corrupt fel water, return to Taronn Redfeather in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:5156:details:0: To the north, along the east of the road in what's called Shatter Scar Vale, is an area where infernals were called down during the last great war--the craters still scar the land, as do the infernals themselves.
rows.quest:5156:details:1: BI am curious about two things. First, are there still entropic elementals roaming the area? And second, are the craters still filled with the corrupt, fetid water that gathered there years ago? Will you help me and check, ⟦17⟧? Be careful though, the infernals destroy anything in their path.
rows.quest:5156:completion:0: Good that you're alive, ⟦18⟧. Bad that the water still exists. I was hoping to find at least one pure source of water here in ⟦E1⟧. It looks like my search has failed. The process of healing the land could have been made much easier with its existence.
rows.quest:5156:completion:1: BI will have to concern myself with saving what forest creatures I can while destroying those that have become so corrupt that they endanger themselves as much as travelers through this once-mighty forest.
rows.quest:5157:obj:0: Take the Empty Canteen to the Moon Well in the center of Jaedenar and fill it before returning to Greta Mosshoof in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:5157:details:0: Deep within Jaedenar lies Shadow Hold--the main fortress of their corruption and evil.
rows.quest:5157:details:1: BThe ⟦E12⟧ has protective spells surrounding their lair in the form of braziers. If I am to find out any more information about our enemy through scrying, then those braziers must be extinguished. By doing so, I should be able to spy on the Council and find out who leads them.
rows.quest:5157:details:2: BIf you can, take this canteen and fill it at the Moon Well in the center of Jaedenar. Return to me afterwards.
rows.quest:5157:completion:1: BNow all we have to do besides apply the waters to the braziers is to have it purified. That should not be difficult--it should only require a little travel.
rows.quest:5157:completion:2: BHopefully we can do this quickly.
rows.quest:5158:obj:0: Take the Corrupt Moon Well Water to Islen Waterseer in the ⟦E14⟧.
rows.quest:5158:details:0: Take the corrupt water to the ⟦E14⟧, ⟦20⟧. South of Ratchet, hidden along the shore, is an old friend of mine, a shaman named Islen Waterseer. She is a powerful shaman who will help us. Her relationship with the spirits of water has always been strong. Our task being a noble one should be enough to persuade her and the spirits of water to aid us in this task.
rows.quest:5158:details:1: BYou should find her at a small camp right along the water's edge. And, ⟦21⟧, ignore the pirates... they are but a nuisance and no threat to you.
rows.quest:5158:completion:0: Ah, you need the water from this Moon Well cleansed. Stopping this force of malice in ⟦E1⟧ seems noble enough, but it is not for me to decide if the water will be purified. I will ask the spirits of water--it will be up to them to decide if the cause is just.
rows.quest:5158:completion:1: BGive me a moment and I will tell them of your plea. I hope they are as sympathetic as I am to your cause.
rows.quest:5159:obj:0: Take the Purified Moon Well Water to Greta Mosshoof in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:5159:details:0: Thank the spirits, ⟦22⟧. They are the ones that have come to your aid, not me.
rows.quest:5159:details:1: BI give this purified water to you now. Please give my regards to Greta and my best wishes. She is tackling something greater than many of us... as I'm sure she will soon find out.
rows.quest:5159:details:2: BThe ⟦E12⟧ is not a force to be trifled with, ⟦23⟧. Remember that.
rows.quest:5159:details:3: BGo now. Take the water and return to Greta.
rows.quest:5159:completion:0: This should be more than enough water for our purposes.
rows.quest:5159:completion:1: BI'm glad to hear that Islen was able to help us. Her strength with the water spirits has always been a strong one. She is also wise, and rare is it that the spirits do not agree with her purpose. The fact that both of them have blessed our task gives me hope that we are on the right path.
rows.quest:5165:obj:0: Using the Purified Moon Well Water, douse the flames of the four braziers of protection within Shadow Hold in ⟦E1⟧, then return to Greta Mosshoof in the Emerald Sanctuary.
rows.quest:5165:details:0: Now, you must return to Jaedenar. The braziers are more than likely spread throughout Shadow Hold. Douse each of their flames and the protections the Council has set up will fall for at least a short period of time. I will be waiting for that to happen. When it does, I will look deep within the Hold and try to find out who the head of this beast is. Then, and only then, will we see about attacking them directly.
rows.quest:5165:completion:0: I was able to see you with my spells as soon as the last brazier's flames died. Well done, ⟦24⟧.
rows.quest:5165:completion:1: BI learned a few things before the ⟦E12⟧'s warlocks were able to recast their spells. Hopefully it will be enough.
rows.quest:5165:completion:2: BFor now, rest. I will tell you what I've learned in a moment.
rows.quest:5202:obj:0: Search through Jaedenar to discover what the Blood Red Key is used for.
rows.quest:5202:details:0: The small red key seems to be made of some kind of bone material. It is heavy in your hand, but appears very fragile. Why would a member of the ⟦E12⟧ have such a thing? Perhaps there is something within Jaedenar that this strange key unlocks.
rows.quest:5202:completion:0: The key, you've found it! Please, give it to me and I can finally escape!
rows.quest:5203:obj:0: Escort Arko'narin to where Lightforge and her equipment are being held, and then protect her as you escape Shadow Hold. Afterwards, seek out Jessir Moonbow in ⟦E1⟧ to let her know what's happened to her friends.
rows.quest:5203:details:0: But, as much as it pains me, there is one thing that must be done first: I have to find Trey's sword Lightforge and escape Shadow Hold to tell my superiors what's happening here. Can you help me, ⟦25⟧?
rows.quest:5203:details:1: BOur equipment isn't far from here, and you've already proven you can survive the path to the top.
rows.quest:5203:details:2: BAfter we escape, I'll head to ⟦E4⟧ if you can find my friend Jessir near the ⟦E2⟧ border. She was to meet us at the Emerald Circle's camp near there.
rows.quest:5203:details:3: BWhat do you say, ⟦26⟧? Can you help me again?
rows.quest:5203:completion:0: You were the one who helped Arko escape? I'm so glad you found me. She passed by here not too long ago on her way to ⟦E4⟧. She had Lightforge in tow and wouldn't even take time to speak to the druids to be healed. She said it was far too urgent.
rows.quest:5203:completion:1: BBut she did tell me about your encounter with Trey's spirit. What a terrible fate for a Knight of the Silver Hand. She didn't show it, but I know it's tearing her up inside, the thought of losing one of her closest friends.
rows.quest:5204:obj:0: Return to Jaedenar and kill the succubus Rakaiah before finding the Remains of Trey Lightforge.
rows.quest:5204:details:0: She would like to pretend that she's fine. She'd love for me to think that she's strong enough to deal with all of this on her own, but I know better than that. Trey's death and hearing the torture he was put through is going to haunt her for a long time, and there's nothing we can do to stop that. But we can give her some peace!
rows.quest:5204:details:1: B⟦27⟧, return to Shadow Hold, kill Trey's torturer and find his remains. There is no reason we can't tie off all these loose ends while Arko'narin mourns in her own private way.
rows.quest:5204:completion:0: You gather the paladin's remains as carefully as you can, recalling that at least his spirit has been released from any pain or suffering that might have been forced upon him.
rows.quest:5242:obj:0: Kill Moora and Salia, and bring Shadow Lord Fel'dan's Head to Greta Mosshoof in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:5242:details:0: Unfortunately, I see the only way to stop this threat to ⟦E1⟧ is a frontal attack. There are no other ways into Shadow Hold, and I have no means to teleport you inside. The straight path down to the bottom is the only way... and I also know who you should seek out. His name is Fel'dan... Shadow Lord Fel'dan. He is the mortal in power down below... he is the head of the serpent. Kill him and his two succubus servants and return to me. Fel'dan is the one making pacts with the Legion. He must be stopped.
rows.quest:5242:completion:0: Earthmother be praised, ⟦28⟧! Thank you! This is a great day, indeed!
rows.quest:5242:completion:1: BThe ⟦E12⟧ will be hard pressed to scale to the same levels of power they once held with this blow to their hierarchy. You have done a great thing this day!
rows.quest:5249:obj:0: Find Starfall Village in ⟦E10⟧ and speak with Wynd Nightchaser.
rows.quest:5249:details:0: In ⟦E10⟧, to the north of here, there are many ancient elven ruins. It's a harsh land, but it holds many secrets and places to explore.
rows.quest:5249:details:1: BWith all my work to do here in ⟦E1⟧, I have not had the opportunity to travel to ⟦E10⟧. But there's no reason why you shouldn't!
rows.quest:5249:details:2: BWhile you're there, look for Wynd Nightchaser. He spends most of his time in Starfall Village and he knows a lot about the area.
rows.quest:5249:completion:0: A friend of Ivy Leafrunner? Nice to meet you, ⟦29⟧.
rows.quest:5385:obj:0: Return the Remains of Trey Lightforge to Jessir Moonbow in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:5385:details:0: You pick up the sack carefully and prepare to make your way back to Jessir Moonbow on the border of ⟦E1⟧ and ⟦E2⟧. Hopefully the paladin will be given the proper respects once you've passed his remains on to his friends.
rows.quest:5385:completion:0: You've done it! Praise be to ⟦E6⟧ and whichever powers you worshihp, ⟦30⟧. You have done an honorable and noble thing this day. I am certain Arko'narin will be pleased that you not only took the time to save her, but to also slay the creature who tortured one of her best friends.
rows.quest:5385:completion:1: BI wish I could do more for you, but please, take this.
rows.quest:5882:completion:0: Very well then, here are your Cenarion plant salves. Scour ⟦E1⟧ for corrupted plants, ⟦31⟧! Wherever they are, use the salve I have given you to purify them.
rows.quest:5883:completion:0: Very well then, here's some Cenarion plant salve. If you find more vitriol when you mine in ⟦E1⟧, remember to hold on to it for me! The more of it you find, the more salve I will be able to make.
rows.quest:5884:completion:0: Excellent work ⟦32⟧ - every bit of this, once we purify it, will help us take back ⟦E1⟧. Here, take some doses of Cenarion plant salve and head into the forest. The reclaiming of the land from the corruption waits for no ⟦33⟧!
rows.quest:5885:completion:0: This is exactly what I need. Here - take these plant salves and use them to reclaim ⟦E1⟧ from the corruption. We must persevere, ⟦34⟧!
rows.quest:5886:completion:0: Here are some Cenarion plant salves - I only need one lesser nether essence for this, ⟦35⟧. Essence is by far the most potent item I can make use of to turn swords into plowshares, as it were. If you need more salve, then find me here!
rows.quest:5887:completion:0: Very well then, here are your Cenarion plant salves. Scour ⟦E1⟧ for corrupted plants, ⟦36⟧! Wherever they are, use the salve I have given you to purify them.
rows.quest:5888:completion:0: Very well then, here's some Cenarion plant salve. If you find more vitriol when you mine in ⟦E1⟧, remember to hold on to it for me! The more of it you find, the more salve I will be able to make.
rows.quest:5889:completion:0: Excellent work ⟦37⟧ - every bit of this, once we purify it, will help us take back ⟦E1⟧. Here, take some doses of Cenarion plant salve and head into the forest. The reclaiming of the land from the corruption waits for no ⟦38⟧!
rows.quest:5890:completion:0: This is exactly what I need. Here - take these plant salves and use them to reclaim ⟦E1⟧ from the corruption. We must persevere, ⟦39⟧!
rows.quest:5891:completion:0: Here are some Cenarion plant salves - I only need one lesser nether essence for this, ⟦40⟧. Essence is by far the most potent item I can make use of to turn swords into plowshares, as it were. If you need more salve, then find me here!
rows.quest:6162:obj:0: Kill Overlord Ror and return his claw to Dreka'Sur at Bloodvenom Post in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:6162:details:0: My husband traveled ⟦E1⟧ for the honor of our clan, doing battle against the ⟦E12⟧ and other corrupt atrocities!
rows.quest:6162:details:1: BAfter he escaped death numerous times, I received a letter from him saying that a druid asked him for help against a great befouled furbolg named Overlord Ror--the two were never heard from again.
rows.quest:6162:details:2: BI want this Ror's clawed hand, ⟦41⟧. I want it to pay for leaving me a widow! I believe the creature is to the south... near the ⟦E2⟧ border.
rows.quest:6162:completion:0: You bring honor to me for following through with your word. My husband died in battle--he would have been proud of that. But I could not rest until I knew that the creature that has forced me to live my life alone paid for what it had done.
rows.quest:8460:obj:0: Grazle wants you to prove yourself by killing 6 ⟦E15⟧ Warriors, 6 ⟦E15⟧ Pathfinders, and 6 ⟦E15⟧ Gardeners. Return to him in southern ⟦E1⟧ near the Emerald Sanctuary when you are done.
rows.quest:8460:details:0: The Timbermaw are the only furbolg tribe to escape the corruption. However, many other races kill furbolg blindly now, without bothering to see if they are friend or foe. For this reason, the Timbermaw furbolg trust very few.
rows.quest:8460:details:1: BAre you interested in proving yourself? Drive back the corrupted ⟦E15⟧ tribe of ⟦E1⟧ and we may one day consider you an ally. You'll find the first ⟦E15⟧ tribe - warriors, pathfinders and gardeners - to my west.
rows.quest:8460:completion:0: We suffer much from the events of the past. Thank you for what you have done to help protect the Timbermaw. As a sign of our growing friendship, please accept this humble offering.
rows.quest:8462:obj:0: ⟦E3⟧ north along the main road in ⟦E1⟧ and speak with the furbolg named Nafien. He stands guard outside the entrance to Timbermaw Hold.
rows.quest:8462:details:0: Perhaps you are capable of handling a larger threat that we Timbermaw face. You certainly have shown yourself capable here...
rows.quest:8462:details:1: BAnother of my kind stands guard outside the entrance to Timbermaw Hold, along this road far to the north. His name is Nafien; while he may appear to be a feral and unsavory beast, fear him not. He only seeks aid against the malign forces that threaten our home.
rows.quest:8462:completion:0: Ah... I have heard the word on the wind about those not of our tribe who seek to ally themselves with the Timbermaw furbolgs. I welcome you, but you must be warned that my tribe reacts poorly to strangers.
rows.quest:8462:completion:1: BThese are trying times, and we can only trust those who choose to fight the corruption of the land alongside of us... and have proven themselves to us accordingly. Those who have not done so will be met with open hostility should they enter the Hold.
rows.quest:8465:obj:0: ⟦E3⟧ through Timbermaw Hold and exit into ⟦E10⟧. Speak with Salfa, who stands guard outside the entrance to Timbermaw Hold.
rows.quest:8465:details:0: The threat of corruption comes not only from the ⟦E15⟧ furbolgs to the south, but also from the east and the Winterfall furbolgs of ⟦E10⟧. If you wish to further aid us, speak with Salfa on the other side of the Hold, by the ⟦E10⟧ entrance. Follow the path to the left to reach it.
rows.quest:8465:details:1: BBe warned - if my kind inside considers you hostile or hated, they will attack. ⟦E3⟧ as quick as you can, avoiding conflict. To kill a Timbermaw - even in self defense - will only alienate you further.
rows.quest:8465:completion:0: Greetings, ⟦43⟧ - I stand guard here as both a speaker for the Timbermaw here in ⟦E10⟧ and as a defender of the tribe.
rows.quest:8465:completion:1: BOur Winterfall brethren here in this frigid land have fallen under the same corruptive sway as the furbolg of ⟦E1⟧. If you've come here offering the Timbermaw furbolgs aid, then we are ready to accept such an offer.
rows.quest:8470:obj:0: Take the ⟦E15⟧ Ritual Totem inside Timbermaw Hold and see if one of the furbolgs there will find a use for the item. The Timbermaw will not speak with you unless you are of Neutral reputation or greater with them.
rows.quest:8470:details:0: You have found one of the ⟦E15⟧ furbolg's ritual totems. The totem itself is of non-descript construction, but a palpable sense of despair emanates from it. If there were any object that might best exemplify the corruption that the ⟦E15⟧ furbolg suffer under, this item would clearly be it.
rows.quest:8470:details:1: BOne of the furbolgs inside Timbermaw Hold may have a use for such an item... that is, if you've earned their trust enough for them to speak with you.⟦44⟧
rows.quest:8470:completion:0: This totem... I recognize it as one of the ⟦E15⟧'s, but it is thick with the stench of decay. Whatever foulness has turned our brethren against us is surely present in this object.
rows.quest:8470:completion:1: BYou were wise to bring this to us, ⟦45⟧. Perhaps through study and ritual, we can uncover what it is that pollutes the minds of our brethren. Thank you, friend please accept these offerings in exchange for your find.
